name: 视频噪声模式分析
description: 分析传感器噪声模式及其时间一致性，以检测视频中被篡改的区域。
useCase: Detecting video 篡改 through noise fingerprint 不一致 跨 frames
mechanism: 提取 photo-response non-uniformity (PRNU) 噪声模式s from video frames and checks temporal consistency. Manipulated regions disrupt the natural 噪声模式, creating detectable boundaries 之间 original and inserted content.
accuracy: Medium-高 - 75-87% on video 拼接 and inpainting
source: Cozzolino, D. & Verdoliva, L. (2020) - Noiseprint: A CNN-Based Camera Model Fingerprint, IEEE TIFS
algorithm: Noise Residual Extraction + PRNU Estimation + Temporal-Spatial Consistency Map
parameters: Denoising: BM3D variant, PRNU window: 30 frames, 块大小: 64x64, Correlation 阈值: 自适应
